scope.current_boundary: Teach that every physical quantity consists of a numerical magnitude and a unit. Do not teach estimation, SI base units, prefixes, derived units, homogeneity, errors, or vectors.
scope.next_boundary_checked: Estimating physical quantities. This lesson only establishes the number-unit pairing needed to report an estimate later.
